content: In 2 Peter, with the Lord a day is like how many years?
explanation: God is not bound by time. “With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.” (2 Peter 3:8, BSB)

content: In 2 Peter, why is the Lord patient?
explanation: He does not want anyone to perish. “not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.” (2 Peter 3:9, BSB)

content: In 2 Peter, how will the Day of the Lord come?
explanation: No one knows the time. “But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief.” (2 Peter 3:10, BSB)

content: In 2 Peter, in what should believers grow?
explanation: To Him be the glory. “But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.” (2 Peter 3:18, BSB)

content: In 2 Peter, how did the prophets speak from God?
explanation: Prophecy did not come from man. “but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.” (2 Peter 1:21, BSB)

content: In 2 Peter, Peter says he did not follow fables but was an eyewitness of what?
explanation: He saw it on the holy mountain. “but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.” (2 Peter 1:16, BSB)

content: In 2 Peter, what did the voice from the Majestic Glory say about Jesus?
explanation: God was well pleased with Him. “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.” (2 Peter 1:17, BSB)

content: In 2 Peter, whom does Peter call a preacher of righteousness?
explanation: God preserved him in the flood. “but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight” (2 Peter 2:5, BSB)

content: In 2 Peter, which brother does Peter mention as writing with God's wisdom?
explanation: Peter calls him beloved. “just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom God gave him.” (2 Peter 3:15, BSB)

content: In 2 Peter, where did Peter hear the voice from heaven?
explanation: He was with Jesus there. “And we ourselves heard this voice from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.” (2 Peter 1:18, BSB)
